newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends session at lows.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends session at lows.

text.p: White sugar futures settled around the day's lows on Tuesday with the focus on the New York market ahead of the May raws expiry.
August closed $1.10 easier at $312.00, while October was $0.30 down at $304.50.
Turnover was light at 1,357 lots, with August trades predominant.
New York was the focus of attention given that the May contract expires on April 30 and speculators are still holding long positions, traders said.
In Paris nearby positions also moved lower but volume was thin.
August was down $1.20 at $312.10 and October down 80 cents at $304.20.
